title: Viññāṇam
text: 1-8 Sāvatthi || || Yo bhikkhave cakkhuviññāṇassa uppādo ṭhiti || pe || Yo manoviññānassa uppādo ṭhiti || pe || jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo || || 9-14 Yo ca kho bhikkhave cakkhuviññāṇassa nirodho || pe || Yo manoviññāṇassa nirodho || pe || jarāmaraṇassa atthagamo ti || || [page 230] 230 UPPĀDA-SAṂYUTTA [XXVI. 4. 1-8
